name: VibeMovie
tagline: An AI-native video editor where you describe edits instead of hunting through menus.

awards: MLH: Best Use of Gemini API

problem: Professional editors are powerful but complex.
solution: Conversational editing over a programmatic video renderer: ask for fades, cuts or text and the edit is applied.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask to fade in the title and see it rendered.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Gemini API” among 261 submissions.
Removes the timeline as a barrier.

lessons: Programmatic video makes AI edits reliable.
